name: New Era Cap, LLC (Koch family, private)
note: Buffalo headwear company founded in 1920 by Ehrhardt Koch. Controlled by its founding Koch family - CEO Christopher H. Koch is the fourth generation - with private-equity firm ACON Investments holding a significant stake (Reuters, 2024-06-06). Completed the acquisition of the '47 brand in August 2024 (company release, 2024-08-08). An IPO Reuters reported it was preparing in 2023 has not been completed.
